title: Duplicate carriage: Peak ticket
topics: Two pointers, windows and prefix sums
summary: The readings are sorted ascending. Compact adjacent equal values into one value, preserving sorted order. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative.
descriptionMd:
Repeated catalog numbers occupy neighboring slots on an already sorted carriage. Tomas is setting the upper stop on an old office gauge. The largest derived reading goes on its label, even if the whole tray is below zero.

The readings are sorted ascending. Compact adjacent equal values into one value, preserving sorted order.

Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative.

Implement duplicateCarriagePeakTicket(readings, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.
unitIntro: Read and write pointers. The readings are sorted ascending. Compact adjacent equal values into one value, preserving sorted order. Keep the sequence order specified here before computing the requested receipt. A scan invariant says what has been processed and what remains. Work through the proof strip first, then change the returned summary without changing the definition of that sequence. The last card revisits loop accumulators from Hello, Keys.
constraints: 1 <= k <= 8. All arithmetic results fit a signed 32-bit integer.
Numeric readings lie between -1,000,000 and 1,000,000, subject to the task's shape and ordering rules.

Target time O(n); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(n). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.
